name: Cemil
description: A krumar warden's assistant of House Fenzala who proves to be a Sultai agent and helps Jurjis reach the Kin-Tree chamber.

timeline.summary: Mehtma, resentful of teaching during the siege, watches Cemil on duty in the chamber and recalls wanting to serve Khan Felothar.
timeline.quote: Mehtma was ready to make a name for herself, to see Abzan in all its glory, to serve Khan Felothar.

timeline.summary: Mehtma glimpses her cows being led by Cemil and chases him to the east gate, finding the guard posts empty and the gate ajar.
timeline.quote: Her cows, in the distance, passing through one of those spears of sunlight, being led by Cemil .

timeline.summary: Cemil flees toward the outer gate and Mehtma races up to the top of the wall to cut him off.
timeline.quote: Cemil dropped the cows' lead and bolted into the darkness, up the enclosed ramp, toward the outer gate.

timeline.summary: On the ramparts Cemil attacks Mehtma with a Sultai sickle and she overpowers and disarms him.
timeline.quote: She swept a foot against the back of his knee, brought him sprawling down, and wrenched the blade out of his hands.

timeline.summary: Cemil says krumar will never be seen as truly Abzan and that he was never House Fenzala but Sultai.
timeline.quote: "I was never House Fenzala," he said. "I am Sultai."

timeline.summary: Cemil reveals the deal he made with Jurjis and flings himself off the battlements into the Sultai fog, dragging Mehtma until he lets go and falls.
timeline.quote: he let go of her wrist and fell into the mist.

timeline.summary: Mehtma realizes the cow ruse was a distraction so that Cemil's passphrase could get House Agach into the Kin-Tree chamber.
timeline.quote: Which Cemil, assistant to the warden, had. The betrayal was unthinkable.

pages_say.description: A krumar warden's assistant of House Fenzala who proves to be a Sultai agent and helps Jurjis reach the Kin-Tree chamber.
